newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Guardian Life Assurance BBB minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Guardian Life Assurance BBB minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it assigned its BBB minus claims-paying ability rating to Guardian Life Assurance Plc.

"The rating assignment reflects the steady decline in new business volume, very high, though declining, level of expenses, adequate level of capitalisation, and increased competition," S&P said in a statement.
"Partially offsetting these weaknesses is the parent company's commitment to the life operations, and renewed focus on the core business," the agency said.

S&P listed the following expectations. -- Operating performance will improve in the near term as expenses will continue to decline and persistentcy and mortality experience remain favourable. -- Annual Premium Equivalents growth will resume in 1997. -- Capitalisation will remain aggressive but adequate for the rating.
